precision_scope: Whole stored output arrays and unrounded fitted matrices/parameters; baseline-vs-native measured directly, candidate-vs-baseline measured directly. Same candidate official precision follows from exact full candidate/baseline gates.
performance_scope: Formal v1/v2 rows preserve all real frames/default iterations. Native clocks include subprocess startup/read/algorithm/write/exit; FNIT application clocks include import/header loading/API/normal writes but omit Python interpreter startup/hashes/evidence save. Function profiles are diagnostics and must not replace formal timings. Native actual thread count was not independently sampled; fixed affinity and 1/8 environment budgets are recorded.
